description: Agent benchmark over a fictional world: arithmetic needs the calculator, every fact needs the lookup tool. See laboratory/agents/tasks.py.

knowledge.Velmora Bridge: The Velmora Bridge is a steel suspension bridge over the Tasso River in Corvane. Construction began in 1904 and the bridge was completed in 1911. It was designed by the engineer Ilse Marquant. Its main span is 412 metres.
knowledge.Ilse Marquant: Ilse Marquant (1868-1939) was a structural engineer born in the town of Brask. She designed the Velmora Bridge and, in 1902, the dome of the Orrin Observatory.
knowledge.Brask: Brask is a mountain town and the capital of the province of Halvern. It was founded in 1532. Population: 18,420 (2020 census). The Selk Mountain Railway starts here.
knowledge.Halvern: Halvern is a mountainous province. Its capital is Brask. Area: 23,600 square kilometres. Its highest peak is Mount Selk.
knowledge.Corvane: Corvane is a port city at the mouth of the Tasso River and the capital of the province of Ostmere. It was founded in 874. Population: 1,284,000. Its main railway station is Corvane Central Station.
knowledge.Ostmere: Ostmere is a coastal province on the Grey Sea. Its capital is Corvane. Area: 15,100 square kilometres.
knowledge.Orrin Observatory: The Orrin Observatory is an astronomical observatory on Mount Selk. It was founded in 1873 by the astronomer Teodor Vaskel. Its dome, added in 1902, was designed by Ilse Marquant. Mira Lund directed the observatory from 1898 to 1925.
knowledge.Teodor Vaskel: Teodor Vaskel (1831-1897) was an astronomer born in Corvane. He founded the Orrin Observatory in 1873 and co-discovered Comet Vaskel-Lund in 1879 with Mira Lund.
knowledge.Mira Lund: Mira Lund (1849-1931) was an astronomer born in the village of Ardent Hollow. She co-discovered Comet Vaskel-Lund in 1879 and directed the Orrin Observatory from 1898 to 1925.
knowledge.Ardent Hollow: Ardent Hollow is a village in the province of Halvern. Population: 2,315.
knowledge.Comet Vaskel-Lund: Comet Vaskel-Lund is a periodic comet with an orbital period of 71 years. It was discovered in 1879 by Teodor Vaskel and Mira Lund. Its most recent perihelion was in 2021.
knowledge.Mount Selk: Mount Selk is the highest peak of Halvern at 3,104 metres. The Orrin Observatory stands on its summit ridge, and the Selk Mountain Railway climbs to it from Brask.
knowledge.Selk Mountain Railway: The Selk Mountain Railway is a rack railway opened in 1896. It runs 11.4 kilometres from Brask to the Orrin Observatory and climbs 1,870 metres.
knowledge.Tasso River: The Tasso River is 618 kilometres long. It rises in Halvern and flows through Corvane into the Grey Sea.
knowledge.Kestrel Bay: Kestrel Bay is a harbour town on the Grey Sea in the province of Ostmere. Population: 46,900. Its landmark is the Kestrel Bay Lighthouse.
knowledge.Kestrel Bay Lighthouse: The Kestrel Bay Lighthouse is a 38-metre stone lighthouse built in 1856. It was designed by the architect Aurel Dunmore.
knowledge.Aurel Dunmore: Aurel Dunmore (1815-1890) was an architect born in Kestrel Bay. He designed the Kestrel Bay Lighthouse and Corvane Central Station.
knowledge.Corvane Central Station: Corvane Central Station is the main railway station of Corvane. It opened in 1888, has 14 platforms and was designed by Aurel Dunmore.
knowledge.Grey Sea: The Grey Sea is an inland sea bordered by the province of Ostmere. Its largest port is Corvane.
